goal: Add a local-first, auditable web research loop to Kimi Code Agent: query the web, select sources, fetch readable content, and return source-backed answers without losing user control.
description: The desktop coding agent needs a dependable web.search and web.fetch tool pair. Search must return structured, source-identifiable results; fetch must enforce read-only network policy, extract readable text, preserve provenance, cache safe repeated requests, and emit actionable errors. The existing Native Agent Host and CLI fallback must not imply web capability when the host cannot run external tools.
tasks: Search configured web providers with query, locale, freshness, and result-limit controls
Fetch and extract readable text from selected HTTP(S) sources
Apply domain, URL, size, timeout, retry, and private-network safeguards
Cache short-lived repeated search and fetch requests to reduce latency and API spend
Return provenance-rich structured results suitable for citations and task audit trails
Expose clear configuration and error-recovery paths for provider credentials
Keep direct fetch, search-provider requests, and third-party MCP integrations composable
safety_requirements: Domain allowlists and provider endpoint validation
Block unsafe private-network fetch targets except explicitly local development paths
Bounded response sizes, timeouts, retries, and cache TTLs
No API key, authorization header, or raw sensitive request header in logs
Structured audit metadata for source, provider, cache status, and failures
